ev.q: Postvaccination surveys identified vaccination marks on 191 (87%) of 220 free-roaming dogs
only two of whom had sought medical evaluation (22%)
Thirteen dogs with rabies-compatible signs* were identified during May 2018 (one), August (one)
17 (65%) of the dogs were known to have been vaccinated during the campaign
target coverage (>70% of susceptible dogs) was achieved
suggesting that dog rabies activity increased in November
it was an emergency outbreak response
